quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: The Children
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x15000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Oh, meow, meow... Where did they go...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Some of those little rascals have run off, and I know not where they've gone. This is most worrying...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The outside is a very dangerous place. Though I have taught them a great many times, those stick-wielding hairy churls and those balls of water and fire are still perilous.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: And if they were to run into the tingly, zappy place, the hair all over their bodies will stand on end. I would not see those little rascals experience something so terrible.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: But there are always some who will not listen and go gallivanting about. I always have to expend much effort to bring them home...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A few of them ran off again today, which is most worrying indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Please, I need your help to find Konbumaru and Hachihou.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's Konbumaru...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A good child. This generation's Konbumaru is a smart one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "This generation," you say?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki would sometimes talk about it. I cannot claim to have understood, but from her expression when she spoke about Konbumaru, it must have been something good.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I name the little ones after good things. And once the little ones are little no more and depart, I will use those same names for ever younger cats.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Konbumaru loves to sleep in high places, so it would be best if you started there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, Hachihou is...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A very agile little fellow, and very fond of fish as well. As such, it will sometimes go to the seaside to look for fish that have washed up on the shore.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: But it is very dangerous. Water is a most frightening thing. A long, long time ago, a certain... tanuki, was it? That fellow fell into the water, and nearly didn't come back.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You can probably find Hachihou by bodies of saltwater, looking for fish or crabs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That scope's too broad...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Really? It's a very high place and a body of saltwater.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, how about we show Neko our map...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You... You really do lack powers of comprehension, don't you? This is the very high place, and this is the saltwater body. They will surely be there.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Then it is in your hands, meow, meow. Ah, these children...

choices.text: I'm no expert in catching cats...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow, meow. Fear not. Those little ones do not fear humans anyway... In fact, you might say that it is precisely because no one plays with them that they always run off by themselves.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Then it is in your hands, meow, meow. Ah, these children...

talks.objective: Go to the seashore and bring the little cat back to the shrine

dialogues.speaker: "Hachihou"
dialogues.text: Meow, meow meow?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so this must be "Hachihou"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, what an obedient little kitty...

talks.objective: Go to the seashore and bring the little cat back to the shrine
Go a high place and bring the little cat back to the shrine

dialogues.speaker: "Konbumaru"
dialogues.text: Meow! Meow meow, meow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That's a fierce little kitten alright. Be careful...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, it sure looked fierce, but guess it's just gonna let you carry it after all, huh?

choices.text: I've come to take you home.

talks.objective: Go to higher ground and bring the little cat back to the shrine

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Found those two children, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a work in progress...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Mm, is that so? Then make haste, lest those two run yet further than they already have.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Have you found them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: You! You never have ears for me, do you? Why can't you both be as good as Meshi?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Meshi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you really do name them after good things...

dialogues.speaker: "Hachihou"
dialogues.text: Meow, meow meow meow... meow...

dialogues.speaker: "Konbumaru"
dialogues.text: Meow! Meow meow!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: No back-talk! Or should I not go and find you, and simply let you... let you go hungry from when the sun is up, to when the moon rises, to when the sun hangs high again, and leave you to find your way home?

dialogues.speaker: "Konbumaru"
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hah, that's a good child. Alright, alright. It's just good that you have returned.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I owe you much. If not for your help, these little rascals would have gone hungry out in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I actually think they would've made it back themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, you have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: If you can spare the time, do come again. I might still have other matters in which you might have a hand.
